title: Tensor evaluation against the dualizing object of a perfect diagonal
statement: Let X and S be Noetherian schemes (locally Noetherian [pqf-def-locnoeth] and quasi-compact [def-weil-pbc-quasi-compact-scheme]). Let f:X\to S be flat [def-weil-flat-morphism] and proper [def-weil-proper-morphism]. Put P=X\times_S X and let \Delta:X\to P be the diagonal [def-pc-base-change]. Choose derived categories [def-pc-derived-category] for X, S and P, and for each open of P in the same derived universe as P. Suppose the single complex \Delta_*\mathcal O_X[0] is perfect on P [def-pc-perfect-complex]. Let R:D_{QCoh}(X)\to D_{QCoh}(S) be equipped with an isomorphism to the restriction of the recorded Rf_* after inclusion in D(S) [def-pc-derived-direct-image], and let a be a specified right adjoint of R. Let h_\Delta witness that R\Delta_* preserves quasi-coherent cohomology, and let c be a specified right adjoint of its full-subcategory restriction defined using h_\Delta. Let O and O_P be quasi-coherent derived objects equipped with isomorphisms of their underlying objects to \mathcal O_S[0] and \mathcal O_P[0]. Then there is an isomorphism a(O)\otimes^L c(O_P)\cong\mathbf 1_{D(X)} in the recorded derived tensor category [def-pc-scheme-derived-tensor-structure]. The derived universes of X, S and P may differ.

proof.text: Use properness and finite type to see that P is Noetherian. The Noetherian direct-image theorem supplies the preservation witnesses. In a common derived universe, lift the comparison for R through the full inclusion, and transfer its adjunction to the canonical restricted direct image. The diagonal counit identity gives O_X[0] isomorphic to c(Lpr_1* a(O_S[0])).

The proper closed diagonal has exact module pushforward, so its derived pushforward of the tensor unit is the given perfect single complex. Apply the perfect immersion tensor formula to K=Lpr_1* a(O_S[0]); its invertible mate gives LDelta* K tensor c(O_P[0]) isomorphic to c(K).

Compose the derived pullback composition and identity comparisons with Delta followed by pr_1 = id. This identifies LDelta* Lpr_1* with the identity. Compose with the preceding two isomorphisms and invert. Transport the two structure objects by a and c. For distinct derived universes, use the equivalences of localizations induced by the identity of complexes; their comparisons with single functors, homology, derived functors and K-flat derived tensor transport this construction and both adjunctions. This establishes the assertion for the specified adjoints.
